tree.heading: Board
tree.text: The term “Board” means the Lime Board provided for under section 6204(b) of this title.

tree.heading: Consumer information
tree.text: The term “consumer information” means any action taken to provide information to, and broaden the understanding of, the general public regarding the use, nutritional attributes, and care of limes.

tree.heading: Handle
tree.text: The term “handle” means to sell, purchase, or package limes.

tree.heading: Handler
tree.text: The term “handler” means any person in the business of handling limes.

tree.heading: Importer
tree.text: The term “importer” means any person who imports limes into the United States.

tree.heading: Lime
tree.text: The term “lime” means the fruit of a citrus latifolia tree for the fresh market.

tree.heading: Marketing
tree.text: The term “marketing” means the sale or other disposition of limes in commerce.

tree.heading: Order
tree.text: The term “order” means a lime research, promotion, and consumer information order issued by the Secretary under section 6203(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Person
tree.text: The term “person” means any individual, group of individuals, partnership, corporation, association, cooperative, or other legal entity.

tree.heading: Producer
tree.text: The term “producer” means any person who produces limes in the United States for sale in commerce.

tree.heading: Producer-handler
tree.text: The term “producer-handler” means any person who is both a producer and handler of limes.

tree.heading: Promotion
tree.text: The term “promotion” means any action taken under this chapter (including paid advertising) to present a favorable image for limes to the general public with the express intent of improving the competitive position and stimulating the sale of limes.

tree.heading: Research
tree.text: The term “research” means any type of research relating to the use and nutritional value of limes and designed to advance the image, desirability, marketability, or quality of limes.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

children.text: “State” means each of the 50 States of the United States, the District of Columbia, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico; and
“United States” means the 50 States of the United States, the District of Columbia, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1993—Par. (6). Pub. L. 103–194 substituted “citrus latifolia” for “citrus aurantifolia”.
